item.title: Chicago's Ratboys Lean Into a Feeling
item.description: Julia Steiner describes the song “Just Want You to Know the Truth” as the emotional centerpiece of Ratboys’ new record, Singin’ to an Empty Chair; it’s the “earth’s core of this little planet of songs,” she explains. The Chicago band’s upcoming sixth full-length, releasing on New West Records, took its name from a line in that song.
